policies.title: Economic growth
policies.statement: Achieve the highest sustained growth in the G7 to increase household incomes and fund better public services.

policies.title: Clean power by 2030
policies.statement: Deliver at least 95% clean electricity by 2030 through renewable energy expansion and the establishment of Great British Energy.

policies.title: NHS recovery
policies.statement: Reduce waiting lists by treating 92% of NHS patients within 18 weeks and increase annual appointments.

policies.title: Housebuilding
policies.statement: Build 1.5 million new homes and fast-track planning decisions on at least 150 major infrastructure projects.

policies.title: Youth employment guarantee
policies.statement: Provide six months of paid work for every 18-21 year old who has been on Universal Credit and searching for work for 18 months.

policies.title: Immigration reform
policies.statement: Restore order in the immigration system to build a firm and fair approach that addresses declining public trust.
